items.title: Percy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: would come over in the daytime and a young tenor player, Andy Kirk Jr., a tremendous tenor player.

ctx.x: Okay, I live on Convent Avenue and Sugar Hill.

Yeah? Well this was 148th right near the subway stop. There used to be a luncheonette there named Al’s. I don’t know if it’s there now, but this was 1949. That’s when we decided, right after I got out of the hospital with this pneumonia, I was getting ready to go to a matinee, got up and coughed and there was blood in my… And I went back to bed to try and sleep it off to get up to go to this matinee, and my fever jumped up and this doctor said, “You’re not going to a matinee. You’re going to the hospital.” Then…
The son of Mary Lou Williams and Andy Kirk . . .
